businessPurpose: Customer setup values must not be guessed. Before assigning posting groups, VAT groups or payment terms to U-CUST-100, the actual setup pages must be visible and explained from the real Business Central UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Each recovered page is accepted only if screenshot text and Page Inspection show the requested setup page.
Business Manager Role Center screenshots are rejected as setup proof.
No setup, master data, document, preview, posting, payment or API shortcut is changed.
The result decides whether CUSTOMER-SETUP-VALUE-WRITE-GATE is ready or still blocked.
stopIf: The active instance or company is not clearly playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
The route requires selecting or saving a setup value.
The UI opens an unexpected page and Page Inspection cannot clarify it.
